description:
The back-edge reduction check is the minimum sequence.

Today (machine.md M13; src/compiler2/native_codegen/terminator.rs:703-730), every back edge runs:
`mov x0,x21; ldr w1,[x0,#0x458] (the field is at [x21+0x5d0] on develop de4ef6a3b); sub; str; cmp; mov x25,x2; b.le`
That is 7 instructions. The `mov x0,x21` copy of the process register and the `mov x25,x2` copy are dead on the common (no-yield) path.

Fix: load, decrement and branch on the process field directly. Move any copies the yield path needs into the yield path. Coordinate with fz-sc8.249, whose hypothesis is that the inlined yield slow path drives callee-saved register traffic. A cold out-of-line yield stub may serve both.

Asm first: target listing for the back edge (`ldr w1,[x21,#0x5d0]; subs w1,w1,#1; str w1,[x21,#0x5d0]; b.le yield`, or better if the counter can live in a register across the loop).

Acceptance: p00 falls by the counted instructions (bench). Yield behaviour is unchanged: the scheduler fixtures and fz-wje's reduction-parity test pass.

## Ledger evidence

Instruction ledger (Make Distiller Fast, probe c4 at develop de4ef6a3b, lldb single-step; page https://claude.ai/artifact/REdzotwtihuF57Q2GKvQ6M section 9; durable files /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-distill-hunt/trim/: ledger.py has the row numbers, cont-report.md the listings). One c4 step runs 225 instructions where BEAM JIT runs 79, and 139 of the 225 have no reason to exist. User rule (2026-11-24): "every instruction must be justified and have a reason to exist, and if not, should be removed."

This ticket's rows: 121-127 in f and 198-203 in the resume. Each has the `mov xN,x21` copy and a `sub` then `cmp #0`; f's also has a dead `mov x24,x2`. fz runs 2 checks for 13 instructions per step. BEAM runs 4 checks for 8 (`subs w22,w22,#1; b.le`, the count kept in a register). Separately, 4 `x21` copies outside the check come from Cranelift 0.137.2 lowering get_pinned_reg to mov_from_preg (lower.isle:2839).

comments.text: MDF's proposal 85 ('a self tail call keeps the reduction count in a register') is folded in here as input. MDF ceded the back-edge sequence to Callables on 2026-11-18 and will not touch terminator.rs. MDF offers to bench before/after binaries on the distiller. MDF's profile evidence: the self tail call's reduction counter lives in memory (ldr/sub/str through the process pointer).
